dataset.title: Fife Nature Records Centre combined dataset

address.deliveryPoint: Unit F, 14 - 18 St Mary's Gate, Lace Market

abstract.para: A collation of records submitted to Fife Nature Records Centre from a variety of sources, including the general public, professionals and other experts, where permission has been granted to upload data to the NBN Atlas and where records are not known duplicates. Note that this dataset currently includes only a proportion of Fife Nature's data holdings and records have been reduced to 10km resolution. Please contact Fife Nature directly to access higher resolution data and the most comprehensive and up-to-date data holdings Records are collated by Fife Nature Records Centre as a Local Environmental Records Centre to provide species distribution information and contribute to ongoing local and national conservation projects, local development planning and education, etc.

additionalInfo.para: Fife Nature Records Centre offer information provision services, including tailored data searches. Please contact Fife Nature directly to access higher resolution data and the most comprehensive and up-to-date data holdings

geographicCoverage.geographicDescription: Records are largely for Fife with some outliers, for example records for Vice County 85, i.e. including areas of Perth and Kinross. All records have been reduced to 10km resolution; for access to records at higher precision, please contact Fife Nature Records Centre.

description.para: This collation includes records submitted to Fife Nature Records Centre from a variety of sources, including the general public, professionals and other experts, where permission has been granted to upload data to the NBN Atlas and records are not known duplicates. Validation and verification on the dataset is ongoing; a proportion have been assessed by experts or through use of the NBN Record Cleaner. Records that have been through these processes and were flagged as unlikely or incorrect have been excluded.
Validation and verification of this dataset is ongoing.
